SELECT uniqExact(toString(properties.location)) AS review_pages_clicked,
       uniqExact(toString(properties.$insert_id)) AS clicks,
       count(DISTINCT person_id) AS clickers,
       round(avg(toFloatOrZero(toString(properties.time_on_page_ms)))/1000, 1) AS avg_decision_s
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(1788192000) AND timestamp < toDateTime(1790784000)
  AND event='affiliate_link_click' AND coalesce(properties.$host,'') = 'easternalignment.com'
  AND coalesce(properties.$geoip_country_code,'') != 'CN'
  AND coalesce(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,'') NOT IN ('localhost:4321','127.0.0.1:8188','127.0.0.1:8765','localhost:8765','127.0.0.1:8931')
  AND (person_id IS NULL OR toString(person_id) NOT IN ('8435b8d5-16b6-5f4b-9b71-f5d4d196ad00','83b89204-633d-56fa-9e65-202e62d839ff','259d7d34-120f-50a6-a260-3e7fa192ae79','8b444548-d415-5d49-88b2-f717feaba288','b7575d9c-8453-5600-874a-47188ad98ec8','01a0b5bc-770d-7c62-b34d-5416ccb6f386'))
  AND match(toString(properties.location), '/reviews[/]')
LIMIT 5
